description.p: GNOME application for measuring distances on screen to help you design and inspect layouts and graphics. Length includes the following features:
Додаток для GNOME який може виміряти дистанції на екрані, щоб допомагати вам розробляти й досліджувати графіку і дизайни. "Лінійка" має наступні функції:
Приложение для GNOME, которое может измерять дистанцию на экране, чтобы помогать вам создавать и изучать графику и дизайн. "Линейка" имеет следующие возможности:
Een GNOME-toepassing voor het meten van afstanden op het scherm. Vooral handig bij het ontwerpen en nameten van grafische elementen. Lengte beschikt over de volgende mogelijkheden:
Applicazione GNOME per misurare le distanze sullo schermo per aiutarti a progettare e ispezionare layout e grafica. Length include le seguenti funzionalità:
Une application pour GNOME pour mesurer des distances à l’écran et vous aider à concevoir et inspecter mises en page et graphiques. Longueur comprend les fonctionnalités suivantes :
Aplicación GNOME para medir distancias en pantalla para ayudarle a diseñar e inspeccionar diseños y gráficos. Longitud incluye las siguientes características:

Meet afstanden in diverse eenheden: pixels, centimeters, inches, pica's, punten of percentages;

description.p: Add the vertical or horizontal CSS class to the application window
Fix inaccurate measures for the diagonal rulers
Disable middle click for locking the position of the mouse tracker. Now only the P keyboard shortcut remains to lock the tracker.
Add angles measurement
The grid and diagonal rulers can now be disabled from the Preferences dialog
Add keyboard shortcuts for showing/hiding the markings (M), the grid (G), the diagonal rulers (I), and the angles (A)
Add a keyboard shortcut (D) for switching between left-to-right and right-to-left
Change orientation on middle click
Add Ukrainian and Russian translations
Prevent the scaling factor from being set to zero
Add the scaling factor feature, which enables to scale the units to adjust the ruler to the object to measure when this object is zoomed, for example
Fix the alpha channel being ignore when opacity is set to zero
Add the relative percentage unit, which enables percentage to be relative to the dimensions of the ruler itself
The alpha channel of the custom background color is now used for the ruler opacity
Use version 48 of the GNOME runtime
Add Italian and Dutch translations
Add a control in the main menu to change the orientation of the ruler
Add help pages
Add diagonal rulers when the ruler window is extended

In some environments, the system does not provide a monitor description, which resulted in Length ignoring the monitor. With this release, Length uses the monitor manufacturer and model when the description is not available.
Add picas and points as units for the ruler
Enable calibration of each monitor in a multiple display environment
Fix wrong monitor detection
Fix quality issues
Fix issue for when the monitor details cannot be retrieved
Fix quality issues
Italian translation
Fix invisible menu button in dark mode
Initial release
